description: This Python source file implements a client for bidirectional streaming communication with AWS SageMaker endpoints using HTTP/2. It provides methods for initializing the client, starting/stopping sessions, sending audio, text, and JSON data, and receiving streaming responses.

classes.name: SageMakerBidiClient
classes.description: Client class for managing bidirectional streaming with AWS SageMaker endpoints, including session management, data transmission, and response handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SageMakerBidiClient with endpoint details and configuration parameters.

methods.name: _initialize_client
methods.description: Configures and creates the underlying HTTP2 client with AWS credentials.

methods.name: start_session
methods.description: Starts a bidirectional streaming session with the SageMaker endpoint, establishing input and output streams.

methods.name: send_data
methods.description: Sends a data chunk (audio, text, or JSON) to the stream with optional data type.

methods.name: send_audio_chunk
methods.description: Convenience method to send audio data as binary.

methods.name: send_text
methods.description: Convenience method to send text data encoded as UTF-8.

methods.name: send_json
methods.description: Convenience method to send JSON data serialized and encoded as UTF-8.

methods.name: receive_response
methods.description: Receives a response event from the stream.

methods.name: is_active
methods.description: Property indicating whether the session is currently active.
